description: A daytime photograph depicting a railway station platform with a blue passenger train stopped on the left. The train prominently displays the name "SALTJÖBANAN" on its side. Several people are visible on the platform, which is separated from the railway tracks by a fence. A set of railway tracks runs down the middle of the image, equipped with overhead power lines (catenary system). To the right of the tracks, there is another paved or unpaved area running parallel to the railway. In the background, beyond the railway infrastructure, are buildings and trees. This image illustrates the land cover classification category "1.2.2 Railways and associated land" as defined in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) documentation, likely for CORINE Land Cover (CLC) or CLC+ mapping.
